_instructions: Sourced strictly from official Government of India portals (MoHFW, NHA, NHM). Field values reflect primary policy documents.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.summary: Flagship health assurance scheme providing a health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation to vulnerable families.
schemes.eligibility: Bottom 40% vulnerable population identified through Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) and expanded state beneficiary lists.
schemes.benefits: Cashless and paperless access to services across 28,000+ empanelled public and private hospitals nationwide, covering pre-hospitalisation (3 days) and post-hospitalisation (15 days).
schemes.how_to_apply: Verification via official portal (mera.pmjay.gov.in), Ayushman App, or at any empanelled hospital / Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and Ration Card.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
schemes.authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)
schemes.summary: National initiative guaranteeing assured, comprehensive and quality antenatal care free of cost to all pregnant women on the 9th of every month.
schemes.eligibility: All pregnant women in their 2nd or 3rd trimesters visiting designated public health facilities on the 9th of every month.
schemes.benefits: Minimum package of antenatal care services including specialist consultation, sonography, blood pressure check, haemoglobin and blood sugar diagnostics, and red-sticker high-risk identification.
schemes.how_to_apply: Walk-in registration on the 9th of each month at any designated Primary Health Centre (PHC), Community Health Centre (CHC), Sub-District or District Hospital.

schemes.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
schemes.summary: Safe motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission promoting institutional delivery among poor pregnant women through conditional cash transfers.
schemes.eligibility: All pregnant women delivering in government health centres or accredited private health facilities in Low Performing States (LPS); BPL/SC/ST pregnant women in High Performing States (HPS).
schemes.benefits: Cash assistance ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹1,400 for rural mothers and ₹900 to ₹1,000 for urban mothers upon institutional delivery, plus ASHA incentives for escort and delivery support.
schemes.how_to_apply: Registration at nearest Anganwadi centre or Sub-centre during early pregnancy with Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card.

schemes.name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
schemes.summary: Entitlement framework ensuring completely cashless delivery and post-natal care for pregnant women and sick neonates in all public health facilities.
schemes.eligibility: All pregnant women delivering in public health institutions and sick infants accessing public healthcare up to 1 year of age.
schemes.benefits: Zero out-of-pocket expenses: free and cashless delivery (including C-section), free drugs, diagnostics, blood transfusion, diet during hospital stay, and free transport from home to facility and return.
schemes.how_to_apply: Automatic entitlement upon admission to any public healthcare institution (PHC, CHC, District Hospital, Medical College).

schemes.name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK)
schemes.authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)
schemes.summary: Universal child health screening and early intervention initiative aimed at improving the overall survival and quality of life for children from birth to 18 years.
schemes.eligibility: Children aged 0–18 years: newborn screening at public health facilities, preschoolers (0–6 years) screened at Anganwadi centres, and school children (6–18 years) in government/aided schools.
schemes.benefits: Systematic screening across the '4Ds': Defects at birth, Deficiencies, Diseases, and Development delays including disability. Free secondary and tertiary management at District Early Intervention Centres (DEIC).
schemes.how_to_apply: Screening is organized through dedicated mobile health teams visiting Anganwadis and schools bi-annually, with referrals to DEICs.

schemes.name: Mission Indradhanush / Intensified Mission Indradhanush (IMI 5.0)
schemes.summary: Strategic catch-up immunisation campaign targeting missed and drop-out children and pregnant women to achieve >90% full immunisation coverage across all districts.
schemes.eligibility: Children under 5 years of age and pregnant women who have missed routine vaccine doses under the Universal Immunization Programme.
schemes.benefits: Free life-saving vaccines protecting against 12 vaccine-preventable diseases including Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Polio, Measles, Rubella, severe childhood Tuberculosis, Hepatitis B, Meningitis, and Pneumonia.
schemes.how_to_apply: Available at routine immunization sessions, Anganwadi centres, health sub-centres, and dedicated outreach campaign sites.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)
schemes.summary: National digital infrastructure establishing longitudinal electronic health records, interoperable healthcare networks, and unique digital health IDs for citizens.
schemes.eligibility: All Indian citizens seeking seamless digital access to their medical records across hospitals, clinics, and diagnostic labs.
schemes.benefits: Creation of Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) 14-digit number, digital sharing of health records with doctor consent, paperless OP registrations via scan-and-share at participating hospitals.
schemes.how_to_apply: Self-creation in under 1 minute via abha.abdm.gov.in or through the ABHA mobile app using Aadhaar or driving licence.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme (PMNDP)
schemes.summary: Public-Private Partnership initiative providing life-sustaining haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis services in district hospital settings.
schemes.eligibility: Patients suffering from end-stage renal disease (ESRD). Patients from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families receive 100% free treatment.
schemes.benefits: Free hemodialysis sessions for BPL patients; non-BPL patients receive treatment at subsidized, pre-negotiated state rates with automated monitoring through the PMNDP portal.
schemes.how_to_apply: Referral from nephrologist or government hospital medical officer with BPL verification and enrolment at empanelled district dialysis centres.
